summary: BioVie Inc. filed Amendment No. 2 to a prospectus supplement (424B5) under its Form S-3 shelf, reducing the at-the-market offering size under its September 11, 2026 sales agreement with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners as sole sales agent to up to $285,000 of common stock, down from the prior $1,225,000. The shares trade on Nasdaq under BIVI; last reported sale price was $1.34 on November 4, 2026, with public float of $17.9 million. This is a routine shelf takedown reduction, not a special situation; watch for dilution and I.B.6 one-third float capacity limits.
